earn.notes: Earns Disney Rewards Dollars, not cash: $1 each, redeemable at Disney U.S. locations or against airline purchases.

rates.note: Disney+, Hulu, ESPN subscriptions and add-ons bought directly on their sites; not via third-party platforms or cable bundles.

benefits.name: Disney streaming credit
benefits.notes: $10 statement credit each month after $10+ on Disney+, Hulu or ESPN subscriptions bought directly at DisneyPlus.com, Hulu.com or Stream.ESPN.com (annual subscriptions get a one-time $10 in the purchase month). Must activate each calendar year; credit posts 6-8 weeks after the purchase.

benefits.name: Theme park ticket credit
benefits.notes: $100 statement credit after $200+ on U.S. Disney theme park tickets (incl. Magic Key passes) bought directly with Disney each anniversary year; vacation-package tickets excluded.

benefits.name: Disney resort Rewards Dollars
benefits.notes: 200 Disney Rewards Dollars after $2,000+ on U.S. Disney Resort stays / Disney Cruise Line bookings made directly with Disney each anniversary year.

benefits.name: DoorDash promo
benefits.notes: $10 off one non-restaurant DoorDash order each calendar month while enrolled in DashPass via the card (12 months complimentary, then paid); applies to DashPass activations from 9/1/2026 (activations 2/1/2025-8/31/2026 get $10 per calendar quarter instead). Offer runs through 12/31/2027.
